# Kaiser CX

> Kaiser CX helps B2B SaaS customer success (CS) teams turn scattered customer signals into automated, prioritized action — so they retain and expand revenue without adding headcount. Founded by Christiane Kaiser, who spent 15+ years building and scaling CS organizations (including nearly a decade leading international CS at Brandwatch). Based in Berlin, Germany; works remotely with SaaS companies across Europe.

## What Kaiser CX offers
- **CONTROL** — a customer success operating system built *inside* your existing CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Planhat and others). It turns scattered signals into automated, prioritized action following a Signal → Logic → Action → Measure model. Delivered as three scoped 4–6 week pilots: (1) Onboarding Tracker, (2) Customer 360° Brief, (3) Retention & Expansion Signal-to-Action. No new tools, no migration, no new headcount. Designed to move Net Revenue Retention (NRR).
- **Advisory** — peer-level thinking partnership for Heads of CS and CS Team Leads: monthly retainer, single 90-minute advisory sessions, and half/full-day team workshops. Complements CONTROL by covering the judgment calls automation can't.

## Resources
- [The Timing Gap — whitepaper](https://kaiser-cx.com/whitepaper.html): Why CS teams miss churn and expansion signals they already have, and how Agentic AI closes the gap. Co-authored by Christiane Kaiser (Kaiser CX) and Caroline Dépierre (Pollup AI).

## Key facts
- Implementation partner: Pollup AI — workflow automation specialists, built on n8n (no black-box tooling). You own the output; no ongoing dependency.
- Primary metric: Net Revenue Retention (NRR). Kaiser CX positions CS as a growth driver, not a cost center.
- Typical pilot: remote, 4–6 weeks, ~2–3 hours/week from one internal stakeholder, fixed project fee (pricing on request).
